items.t: Why Is Adobe (ADBE) Forecasting $47.5 Billion In Cyber Week Sales?
items.sum: Adobe (NasdaqGS:ADBE) projects US$47.5b in global online sales for Cyber Week, covering Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday 2026. The projection is based on Adobe's analytics of digital transactions and trends across major retail platforms ahead of the holiday period. items.t: Adobe’s 33% 2026 Slide is Worth Buying Says Wall Street Analyst Predicting 60% Gains After Recent Re-Rating
items.sum: Adobe and Autodesk both beat estimates and raised guidance on AI demand, yet investors price them very differently. One bets on a billion users, the other on deep workflow lock-in, and a December report could decide which story wins.

items.t: ADBE Stock On Track For 4-Day Rally: Adobe Reports Surge In AI Traffic, $7.1B Thanksgiving Sales
items.sum: Adobe forecast $12.9 billion online sales on Black Friday, up 9.2% YoY and a record $15.1B on Cyber Monday, up 6.2% YoY in this year’s holiday spending.

items.t: Adobe (ADBE) Stock Looks Like A Bargain On Earnings
items.sum: Adobe has become a valuation puzzle, with the stock at US$232.83 after a long slide and investors asking whether that price still lines up with what its earnings can reasonably support. The focus is now less on product buzz around artificial intelligence and more on how much profit power the market is actually paying for. items.t: Adobe sees record $21.3B in holiday buy now, pay later sales. Fed says over 1 in 4 users fell behind. Can you keep up?
items.sum: Don't blow your budget for the new year by falling into the buy now, Pay Later trap.

items.t: Adobe: Almost Priced For A 50% Collapse Despite Record Cash Flow
items.sum: Adobe is rated a Strong Buy at $232.83 and 8.31x estimated 2026 free cash flow; a conservative DCF implies $404.25 per share.
